## Change

Describe the behavior changed, relevant issues and any real PR dependency.

## Checks

- [ ] `bun run typecheck` passes.
- [ ] `bun run test` passes.
- [ ] `bun run build` passes.
- [ ] The changed behavior was observed running (app, browser or phone), not only built.
- [ ] Workflow/packaging changes are listed above, so the owner can decide whether to run Check or Package on this branch (docs/ci.md).

## Release

Nothing is published, tagged, version-bumped, dispatched or merged unless
the owner explicitly asks (AGENTS.md); this PR is not that request. State
whether the owner asked.
